env._REVENUECAT_comment: RevenueCat PUBLIC SDK key (Project settings > API keys > App-specific public key). PUBLIC only: it reads offerings and posts receipts, and ships inside the IPA anyway. The SECRET sk_ key and the webhook secret never leave .env / supabase secrets. EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ANDROID IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, NOT EMPTY: there is no Play account yet, and EAS REJECTS an empty-string env value outright ('is not allowed to be empty'), which failed build 41 on its first attempt. src/lib/iap reads it as undefined and Android stays honestly unable to sell. This key is inlined at BUNDLE time, which is two different moments: eas build reads THIS block, and eas update reads the EAS production ENVIRONMENT on the server and nothing else (EAS CLI runs expo export with EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1, so .env is ignored too). An OTA compiled without it switched the store OFF on every device that took the update, build 43 included (2026-09-22). Every EXPO_PUBLIC_* here must ALSO live in the EAS production environment; npm run check:review fails if one is missing.
